primary_comparison: v27_psc_bs against safety_anchor and mean of five prevalence_random contexts
guarded_win_definition: fairness improves AND delta AUC >= -0.01 AND delta logloss <= +0.05
catastrophic_utility_tail: delta AUC relative to safety anchor < -0.05

gates.2_anchor_mean_fairness: mean delta smooth-EO^2 vs safety anchor < 0
gates.3_anchor_mean_auc: mean delta AUC vs safety anchor >= -0.005
gates.4_anchor_mean_logloss: mean delta logloss vs safety anchor <= +0.01
gates.6_vs_random5: fairness win >=60%, guarded win >=50%, mean delta AUC >= -0.005
gates.7_both_tfms_transfer: for each of TabPFN3.5 and TabICLv2, mean delta smooth-EO^2 vs anchor <0 and mean delta AUC >= -0.01
gates.8_not_single_dataset: at least 5/9 datasets have negative mean delta smooth-EO^2 vs anchor
gates.9_tail_vs_candidate: PSC-BS catastrophic AUC-tail rate <= valfair_random_search16 candidate tail rate, both relative to same safety anchor
